sentences.text:
Imran vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42206 of 2022
Applicant :- Imran

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rohit Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by the learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.
Learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for opposite party no.2 are present.

In compliance of the Court' order dated 05.01.2023, trial court has transmitted the certified copy of the order sheet dated 18.01.2023, certified copy of the compromise deed dated 18.01.2023 and photo copy of the verification order dated 18.01.2023.
Imran along with other persons has signed the compromise deed, and apart from this, Tarana has also verified the compromise deed.
As the dispute is matrimonial, compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely.
The compromise deed has been verified by the trial court.
Certified copy of the compromise deed and certified copy of the verification order passed thereon shall form part of the order.

As the compromise deed of the parties has been verified by the trial court and the same is accepted by this Court, hence, the entire proceedings in Case No. 3645 of 2017 (State Vs. Imran and others),
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Madan Mohan Gate,
District Agra, arising out of Case Crime No. 39 of 2016, are hereby quashed against Imran.
